scope: Only the eight cleanup files and three corrected view files use baseline bytes; every other manifest input is the same current source on both sides.
limits: Complete fresh manifests were compared; this is not a live deployment or legacy-baseline runtime qualification.
Catalog snapshots compare stable definitions and ACLs, excluding OIDs, seed-row identities/timestamps, sequence counters and physical storage.
No permission, MFA, metadata publication, human-review controls or serving databases were changed.

tableInventory.scope: Unique schema-qualified CREATE TABLE declarations with a parenthesized definition in ddl/common/**/*.sql; excludes PARTITION OF declarations and tables generated at runtime. Saved-catalog checks intersect these names with installed ordinary/partitioned tables.
